hardware.variant: One assembled Mosaico with the left-slot SmartSens SC101IOT, PID 0xda4a at 7-bit SCCB address 0x68.

inputs.name: RAM kernel #20 with CAM and AXI diagnostics, inner FIT
RAM kernel #21 with receiver-first startup and short-frame handling, inner FIT
RAM kernel with production DVP driver, inner FIT

scenario: Start V4L2 capture on a running R5 board. Queue memory-mapped buffers, issue STREAMON and dequeue three 640 × 480 UYVY frames. Check bytesused, checksum the full payload and sample luma at 4800 positions in each frame. For the application throughput test, start a monotonic timer immediately after STREAMON and stop it after the last dequeue and payload validation.
expected: The receiver accepts an initial partial frame boundary, continues capturing, and returns complete frames of 614400 bytes to the application.
observed: On #20, DMA reported a successful EOF at 399975 bytes and the driver stopped. On #21 the first successful EOF contained 387695 bytes. The driver discarded that partial frame and delivered three full frames. FNV-1a checksums in order were 712e2d39dffb99a5, c8db0cd937f1e08b and c47963ad54e925d6. The sampled luma ranges were 100–128, 101–124 and 98–123. Mean luma across the four horizontal bands of the first frame was 107, 110, 113 and 115. Three independent open/STREAMON/STREAMOFF cycles subsequently returned nine complete frames with nine distinct checksums. On the production kernel, a user application read /dev/video0, scaled UYVY to 320 × 240 RGB565 and submitted 102 complete frames to /dev/ttyE0 in its first preview run. During the repeat preview the operator saw the live scene and the movement of a hand in front of the lens on the built-in display. In a separate run on the production kernel, userspace dequeued sequence numbers 0 through 35, each with 614400 bytes and a distinct checksum, in 4.6161 s (7.80 frames/s).
limits: The measurements cover one left-slot module at 640 × 480 with an R5 LittleFS root. The sensor table specifies nominal 15 fps. The vendor-firmware 1280 × 720 preview is recorded separately.
